## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user.

## Validation

State build/test results and any physical checks. Identify untested hardware behavior.

## Review

- [ ] Scope is focused and working behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests/docs and HID/IPC compatibility were considered.
- [ ] No private identifiers, captures, keys or binaries were added.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] Commits are signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin.
